summary: Frontend-only verification of ALWAYS-OAUTH-ON-ADD (iter59). Logged in as admin (support@use-bracket.com), opened project 'Emergent Media Plan' (10db10f0-c0ed-427b-afd5-ad553da6b97e), opened Add-Source dialog via psb-add-source, and clicked provider tiles with window.open patched to capture calls. All three review requirements verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL at 1920x800.

always_oauth_on_connected_provider_figma.details: Figma tile renders with 'Add' badge (status=connected). Clicking add-source-option-figma triggered window.open('about:blank','bracket-oauth',...) AND a GET /api/connect/figma/auth-url; popup.location was then set to https://www.figma.com/oauth?... — real OAuth was launched. No GET /api/connect/figma/sources was fired before OAuth (would indicate silent reuse of old picker). add-source-list was NOT rendered.

always_oauth_on_available_provider_gmail.details: Second usable provider Gmail (status=available, badge 'Connect') → clicking add-source-option-gmail also fired window.open + GET /api/connect/gmail/auth-url; popup.location set to https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/v2/auth?... . Confirms every usable provider always OAuths.

provider_status_badges.details: Connected figma shows badge 'Add' (clickable, OAuths). Available gmail/slack/github show 'Connect' (clickable, OAuth). Notion shows 'Setup' (disabled). whatsapp/teams/adobe/gdrive/dropbox/linear show 'Soon' (disabled).

coming_soon_gating.details: Clicking disabled whatsapp tile produced 0 window.open calls and 0 auth-url requests. All 'Soon'/'Setup' tiles have disabled=true attribute in DOM.

regression_popup_close_and_reopen.details: While OAuth was in flight for figma, all provider rows correctly showed disabled=true (list becomes non-interactive during connecting). After closing dialog via add-source-close and reopening via psb-add-source, provider disabled states reset — figma re-enabled ('Add'), gmail/slack/github re-enabled ('Connect'), soon providers still disabled. No stuck state. Confirms the setInterval popup-watch + open-effect reset chain from iter57 still works.

critical_code_review_comments: AddSourceDialog.pick now unconditionally calls startOAuth — matches product intent. No dead code from old inline-sources path remains in pick().
loadSources is still invoked only after 'bracket-oauth:{key}:ok' postMessage, so a cancelled/closed popup correctly does NOT show the picker (verified: no /sources request after clicking figma).
setInterval watchdog (600ms) clears connecting state if popup is closed early — good UX guard against stuck disabled list.
reconnect chip flow (iter58) unchanged and still uses same startOAuth → consistent with new always-OAuth rule.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing admin project 'Emergent Media Plan' and existing figma integration_account (shuklasaksham01@gmail.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter59 always-OAuth verified: clicking ANY usable provider tile (including already-connected figma) fires window.open + GET /connect/{key}/auth-url. Picker only appears after the popup posts bracket-oauth:{key}:ok. Coming-soon tiles remain non-clickable. Regression: closing/reopening dialog resets disabled state properly.
